text:
Melanie: perfwatch fired an alert for increased latency on inference kernel selection at 03:12 UTC — p50 for redwood-v2-small jumped ~35% across canaries
Ravi: saw it too, top-of-nightdash looked like kernel selection time spiked, not just token latency
Hao: also seeing a KV eviction uptick around the same window, could be interaction between prefetch heuristics and kernel probe
Priya: any recent merges touching selector/batching? I remember a merge earlier that toggled prefetch defaults
Melanie: yes, merged PR 8f3a7d4 (batching heuristics + prefetch opt) ~02:50 UTC. CI perf passed but small sample.
Ravi: I'm kicking off a quick bisect on the canary job, will run our perf harness with --short-run and the new kernel-prober logs
Ravi: linking profiler output for the suspect run:
```
[2026-03-18T03:11:48Z] kernel_selector: decision took 1.9ms (baseline 0.4ms)
[2026-03-18T03:11:48Z] selected_kernel: cuda_fused_attention_v3
[2026-03-18T03:11:48Z] kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.42 (normal ~0.05)
[2026-03-18T03:11:48Z] batching: microbatch_slots_lost=12
```
Hao: that decision_time delta is huge — implies selector path fell back to expensive heuristics or probed too many kernels
Priya: I can patch a revert and deploy to canary if bisect hits 8f3a7d4. Want me to hold?
Ravi: please wait, I'll attach git-bisect range. Bisect plan: start from last-green 2012300000 -> HEAD, run perf harness across 6 commits
Melanie: @deploy-bot can you pause the staged rollout for redwood-v2-small? We don't want more canaries exposed until we triage
sre-bot: perfwatch alert acknowledged by eng-runtime; auto-snooze 30m; investigation channel pinned
deploy-bot: Staged rollout for redwood-v2-small paused by request of Melanie at 03:20 UTC
Hao: quick hypothesis — the prefetch policy change increases KV churn which inflates kernel probe count (selector sees more cache misses, probes fallbacks), causing selection latency and batching loss
Ravi: bisect round 1 running now (6/6 commits). If it points to the PR, I'll run a variant that disables prefetch toggle to confirm
Priya: noted — if confirmed I can submit revert PR with tests and a forced canary patch. Will also add a short perf CI job to the merge pipeline to catch this pattern
Melanie: thanks team. Keep thread updates short. If someone gets a clear repro, drop the raw perf trace here and I'll open an incident ticket. :thumbsup:
